## The claim

P4-26: label-derived adverse effects flag a conflict between at least one shortlisted candidate and one of the child's own phenotypes

**Prediction if true.** in OnSIDES, at least one shortlisted approved drug carries a labelled adverse effect matching nephrocalcinosis, growth failure or myopathy, above the rate of a matched set of approved drugs not on the shortlist

**What would refute it.** no shortlisted drug carries any of those adverse effects, or the shortlist rate is no higher than the comparison set's
